title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
WHO WE ARE

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac https://spreadprivacy.com/introducing-duckduckgo-for-mac/, Windows https://spreadprivacy.com/windows-browser-open-beta/, iOS https://spreadprivacy.com/duckduckgo-privacy-browser-ios14/, and Android https://spreadprivacy.com/introducing-app-tracking-protection/, our search engine https://duckduckgo.com/, and the DuckDuckGo subscription https://duckduckgo.com/pro. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai https://duck.ai/, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Our culture https://duckduckgo.com/how-we-work of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

YOUR TEAM AND ROLE

Working on the Data Science Functional Team, you'll drive product and business impact through statistical modeling, experiment design, Bayesian marketing analysis, and classifier implementation across our search engine, instant answers, AI, and revenue optimization, and work on related projects. Recent projects include:

- Defining core growth metrics for our products and building the infrastructure to monitor trends and anomalies

- Measuring the impact of major marketing campaigns for Duck.ai http://duck.ai, translating full-funnel data into actionable decisions

- Building monitoring pipelines to detect unexpected shifts in search traffic patterns faster and more reliably

- Expanding evaluation datasets for page context understanding across complex scenarios like multi-tab browsing and content reattachment

- Improving the trigger systems that determine when AI-assisted answers surface in DuckDuckGo Search, balancing quality and our privacy-first approach

 

Our data meets rigorous privacy standards and is necessarily sparse, so you'll need to think creatively to surface actionable insights in an evidence-first culture where quantitative rigor is the baseline, not the exception.

 

ABOUT YOU

- You have 7+ years of experience in Data Science and a track record of leading high-complexity projects from scoping to production with minimal direction.

- You can do 2 or more of the following:

- Deploy and iterate on ML in production environments

- Develop and deploy NLP solutions

- Apply knowledge of LLMs including fine-tuning, LLM-as-judge, and AI-assisted development

- Conduct marketing campaign analysis using Bayesian methods

- You write production-grade code in Python or a comparable high-level language.

- You have advanced SQL and query optimization skills, familiarity with columnar databases like BigQuery, Clickhouse, Redshift, or Druid; experience with a BI tool like Tableau or PowerBI is a plus.

- You can design, implement, and analyze experiments across product surfaces, and are comfortable deriving insights from sparse or privacy-constrained data.

- You collaborate effectively with product teams and contribute to overall team throughput.

COMPENSATION

$178,500 USD annually and stock options. Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.

 

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

 

Our Team Member Support Guide https://duckduckgo.com/assets/hiring/team_support_guide.pdf explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.

HIRING PROCESS

Hiring works best

title: Assistant Controller
description:
Privia Health is seeking a highly motivated and results-oriented Assistant Controller to join our accounting team. Reporting to the Corporate Controller, this key leadership role will be instrumental in scaling our financial operations, strengthening internal controls (SOX), driving key accounting workflows, and leading finance system transformations. The ideal candidate brings a strong mix of public accounting and public company experience, with expertise in U.S. GAAP, audit readiness, and leading remote teams.
Primary Job Duties:
Financial Operations & Close Management

• Direct month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close routines to ensure accurate, timely, and GAAP-compliant financial statements and reconciliations.

• Oversee the review of journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and supporting schedules across business units.

• Partner with FP&A on budget-to-actual variance analyses and operational reporting to deliver actionable insights.

• Lead financial integration activities for mergers and acquisitions (M&A) to ensure seamless onboarding and accounting alignment.

• Direct or assist with specialized initiatives and projects as needed, demonstrating strong project management capabilities and a focus on enhancing operational processes.

• Technical Accounting, SEC Reporting & Governance

• Provide technical accounting guidance on complex transactions, including purchase accounting (ASC 805), revenue recognition (ASC 606), leases (ASC 842), and new accounting standards.

• Oversee the preparation of supporting accounting data, reconciliations, schedules, and technical input for SEC filings (Forms 10-K, 10-Q, and 8-K) prepared by the Financial Reporting team.

• Maintain and monitor the company’s internal controls framework to ensure full SOX 404 compliance.

• Serve as a key liaison for external auditors, managing audit schedules, requests, and issue resolution.

• Systems, Transformation & Process Improvement

• Serve as the functional finance lead for the upcoming ERP transition, assisting with chart of accounts design, data migration, user acceptance testing (UAT), and workflow design.

• Identify and execute automation opportunities across existing financial software to streamline close cycles and operational routines.

• Treasury Operations

• Support operational treasury functions, including banking relationships, electronic fund transfers (ACH/wires), account structure administration, and positive pay management.
• Team Leadership & Development

• Manage, mentor, and foster accountability across a fully remote accounting team.

• Establish clear performance goals to foster continuous development and cross-functional alignment.

• Education : Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance.
• Certification : Certified Public Accountant (CPA) required.
• Experience: 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, combining public accounting (Big 4 or large regional preferred) and public company environment experience.
• Background in healthcare, physician practice management, or health-tech environments preferred.
• Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of U.S. GAAP, SOX 404 compliance, internal controls design, and the management of internal and external audit engagements.
• Leadership: Proven track record of hiring, managing, and developing remote accounting professionals.
• Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact effectively across executive leadership, IT, HR, and external auditors.
• Systems: Experience with Workday Financials and/or Microsoft Dynamics highly preferred.
• Specialized Skills: Direct experience with enterprise ERP implementations, income tax provision oversight, or corporate treasury operations highly preferred.

The Data Product Owner leads several cross-functional scrum teams responsible for delivering outcome-based data solutions to the business. This role is defined by the problems it solves , not the technology it uses. Whether the right answer is a Tableau dashboard, a Snowflake Cortex agent, a Python-based insight package delivered as a Streamlit portal, or a reusable component of our semantic model, the Data Product Owner is accountable for choosing the approach that best achieves the desired outcome and for guiding their teams to build it.

Our stakeholders are primarily internal, though some solutions serve external audiences, and their needs evolve quickly. This person must be comfortable operating in an environment where both Technology and Product direction change, treating that change as a normal condition rather than a disruption. A major part of the mandate is enablement: building the foundational pieces - starting with a well-structured semantic model - that let stakeholders and teams across the organization build their own solutions, inside and outside of Technology. • Partner closely with Product leaders and internal stakeholders who depend on these solutions, keeping all parties aligned on priorities, tradeoffs, and delivery status.

• Anticipate and absorb change from both Technology and Product, adjusting priorities and communicating impacts without losing delivery momentum.

• Ensure solutions meet quality, security, and compliance expectations appropriate to internal and external use.

• Track adoption, usage, and business impact, and use those insights to continuously refine the portfolio.

description:
The Pharmacy Access Manager supports Patient Services programs by strategically navigating the patient access process from prescription intake through treatment initiation. This role combines patient access and reimbursement expertise with a pharmacy technician background and to identify and address barriers related to coverage, authorization, prescription processing, pharmacy coordination, affordability, and fulfillment.
Candidates must hold an active Pharmacy Technician license in their state of residence
AND
Be willing and able to obtain a Texas Pharmacy Technician license
The Pharmacy Access Manager serves as a central point of coordination among patients, healthcare providers and their office staff, payors, specialty pharmacy, dispensing and non-dispensing pharmacies, client stakeholders, and internal PRO-spectus teams. The role provides guidance and support throughout the access journey, helping ensure prescriptions and required documentation move efficiently through benefit verification, prior authorization, pharmacy processing, and treatment initiation.
Using pharmacy technician knowledge and experience, the Pharmacy Access Manager supports pharmacy-related case activities, identifies missing or incomplete prescription information, coordinates with pharmacy partners, and helps resolve prescription processing and fulfillment barriers. • Monitor prescription progression and proactively identify pharmacy, coverage, authorization, or operational barriers that may delay patient access to therapy.

• Support prior authorization and appeals processes by coordinating required information and documentation with healthcare provider offices, payors, pharmacies, and internal teams.

• Assist with coordination of copay assistance, patient assistance programs, foundation support, or other affordability resources, as applicable to the program.

• Serve as a primary point of contact between internal and external teams, including patients, providers, payors, pharmacies, facilities, client stakeholders, and other program partners.

• Provide education and guidance to provider offices regarding program processes, prescription requirements, coverage considerations, required documentation, and available patient support resources.

• Communicate case status, outstanding requirements, next steps, and barriers clearly and accurately to appropriate stakeholders.

• Effectively manage and prioritize competing demands, including insurance approval timelines, prescription processing requirements, patient treatment schedules, pharmacy timelines, and stakeholder communications.

title: Jr Controllership Analyst - Brazil
description:
ABOUT ARQ

ARQ is one of the fastest-growing fintechs in the world. Our mission is to redefine how people interact with money across borders, building the backbone to move value seamlessly. We’re still early in our journey, which means every person who joins shapes the future of our product, culture, and growth. If you’re excited by big challenges, global impact, and the chance to grow fast with a world-class team, ARQ is the place to do it.

The Role
As a Junior Controllership Analyst, you will be part of the team that ensures the quality of ARQ’s accounting and financial information across multiple geographies, with an initial focus on Brazil. With support and mentorship from the senior team and local controllers, you will take part in day-to-day accounting and the monthly close, reconciliations, and regulatory reporting, learning first-hand how a regulated fintech operates at scale and across different jurisdictions. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to grow fast in a highly complex environment, with international exposure and constant learning.

What you’ll be doing

- Journal Entries & Month-End Close: Prepare journal entries and support the monthly close of the group’s entities across more than one geography, following the calendar and routines defined by the team.

- Reconciliations: Perform bank, general ledger, and customer balance reconciliations, identifying differences and supporting the investigation and resolution of open items.

- Regulatory Reporting: Support the preparation and validation of documents and reports to local regulators (such as CADOCs to the Central Bank in Brazil), together with the senior team.

- Financial Statements: Support the preparation of trial balances and financial statements for the group’s entities, including notes to the financial statements, and assist with requests from the local external audits and the consolidated audit.

- Tax Obligations & Intercompany: Support accounting-to-tax reconciliations, tax and withholding tracking, and the recording of intercompany transactions between group entities.

- Local Accounting Standards & Consolidation: Support the understanding of differences between each country’s accounting practices (such as Brazilian GAAP/CPC, US GAAP, and IFRS) and the preparation of information for the group consolidation.

- Process Improvement: Help document routines and identify automation opportunities, working with Finance, Product, and Data.

What you’ll need

- Degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field (final year or completed)

- 1 to 2 years of experience in accounting or controllership (internships count)

- Basic knowledge of statutory accounting and Brazilian accounting practices (CPC)

- Intermediate Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, reconciliations)

- Organization, attention to detail, and commitment to deadlines

- Eagerness to learn and to work at a fast pace

- Intermediate English

Nice-to-haves

- Experience in a financial institution, fintech, consulting, or audit

- Familiarity with COSIF, CADOC, and Central Bank regulation

- Familiarity with US GAAP, IFRS, or accounting in other Latin American countries

- Familiarity with accounting ERPs and data tools (SQL, Power BI)

- Knowledge of payments, FX, or digital asset products

- Postgraduate degree, MBA, or certifications in progress (CRC, IFRS)

title: Technical Support Specialist, Tax
description:
This role is fully remote, open to candidates based anywhere in the United States outside New York, with a preference for the Pacific or Mountain time zones. Based in New York? Apply to the New York posting of this role instead.
A Different Kind Of Job Description
At Filed , we believe in radical transparency. Everything is open: company finances, team salaries, stock options, anonymous team feedback. That extends to how we talk about this job. So instead of a list of perks, we'll start with what's genuinely hard about it, then tell you why it might be the best move you'll make.
What's hard about this job
The pace is fast. We're a young company growing quickly, and our customers are tax firms in the middle of their busiest weeks. When something isn't working for them, they need an answer today, not next week.
Tax season is tax season. You've lived it as a preparer, so you know. January to April is our busiest stretch too. The difference is that you'll be the one helping hundreds of preparers get through it, not grinding through your own stack.
Not every answer is in a help doc yet. We're building the playbook as we go. Some days you'll be the first person to see a problem, and you'll need to work out what's happening before anyone else can.
Customers aren't always calm. A preparer with a deadline and a stuck return isn't at their most patient. You'll need to stay steady, clear and kind when they're not.
Why it might be the best career move you'll make
You've done the work, so you're the one they trust. Most support teams can't tell a K-1 from a W-2. You can. When a firm calls in, you understand their problem in the first minute, and that makes you far more valuable than a typical support hire.
You'll learn how software gets built. You'll write the tickets our engineers work from, reproduce issues and test the fixes. Few roles give a tax professional this much exposure to how a product is made. People who start here move into QA, product, onboarding and customer success.
You'll grow as fast as we do. Filed is adding millions of dollars of revenue every quarter, and the support team is still small. The people who join now will help shape how it's built and who it hires next.
You'll see the impact immediately. A workaround you find on Tuesday saves a firm hours on Wednesday. A ticket you write becomes a fix that every firm on the platform benefits from.
We've raised $17.2 million to date, led by Northzone, and we work with tax firms across the country, from regional practices to some of the biggest names in the profession.
What You'll Own
As a Technical Support Specialist, you're the person a firm reaches when something isn't working, and the person who makes sure it gets fixed properly:

• Answering customer questions quickly and clearly, in the support inbox and on calls

• Troubleshooting issues inside Filed and the tax software firms already use

• Reproducing problems so engineering can see exactly what the customer saw

• Writing clear, complete Linear tickets that engineers can act on straight away

• Finding workarounds that keep firms moving while the fix is being built

• Spotting patterns in what customers report and flagging them before they spread

Your Hard Skillset

• You've worked as a tax preparer and know what a correct return looks like

• Experience in a ticketing system such as Pylon, Zendesk, Intercom or Freshdesk, and you're used to replying fast without cutting corners

• Some QA or technical background: testing software, reproducing bugs, or writing up issues for a technical team

• Comfortable in at least one major tax platform, such as CCH Axcess, UltraTax, Lacerte, ProConnect, Drake or GoSystem

• Bonus if you've written bug reports or worked in Linear, Jira or a similar tool

Your Soft Skillset

• Calm under pressure, and patient with people who are stressed

• Clear writing: your tickets and replies leave no room for confusion

• Curious: you want to know why something broke, not just that it did

title: Product/Design Recruiter
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies-from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups-use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The recruiting team seeks to build the culture of Stripe by aligning the strongest global talent to our highest impact business needs. They focus on bringing Stripe’s operating principles to life in their recruiting processes, providing the highest-quality candidate experience, and leveraging data driven storytelling to influence the business.

What you’ll do

To further this important mission, we are looking for a driven and collaborative Product & Design Recruiter to grow and scale our global product management and design organizations. You can expect high-impact and wide-ranging responsibility: owning full-cycle recruiting for specialized product and design searches, contributing to our geographic strategy through talent market insights, and delivering an exceptional candidate experience.

This person must be a builder who thrives in a learning environment-unafraid to try new things, embrace new ideas, navigate ambiguity, and welcome suggestions for how we can iterate on our processes.

Responsibilities:

- Partner with senior leaders across product management and design to understand hiring objectives and develop recruiting strategies tailored to each organization’s needs.
- Own full-cycle recruiting across product management and design disciplines, including product design, brand design, content design, design engineering, web presence design, and UX research.
- Build a deep understanding of the skills, experience, and craft required for product and design roles, partnering with hiring teams to define profiles and align on evaluation criteria.
- Develop strategic sourcing and engagement plans to attract product and design talent across different geographies, including passive senior candidates.
- Use talent market insights to advise hiring leaders on candidate availability, search strategy, and geographic opportunities.
- Track and analyze recruiting metrics, share hiring progress with product and design leadership, and use insights to improve search outcomes.
- Initiate creative and scalable improvements to recruiting processes while maintaining a high-quality candidate experience.
- Work closely with Finance, People Ops, Benefits, Onboarding, and Legal to deliver a high-quality and holistic candidate experience.

Minimum requirements

- 7+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including 4+ years recruiting across product management and design in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, with in-house experience.
- Experience supporting hiring across both product management and design, with a track record of building high-performing teams and delivering an exceptional candidate experience.
- Ability to understand distinct product and design profiles and translate business needs into effective search strategies.
- A growth mindset and flexibility to shift tasks and priorities as business needs change.
- An active, data-driven approach to problem-solving, using recruiting trends and market insights to improve processes and outcomes.
- Proven ability to attract passive senior candidates and build diverse pipelines across different hiring locations.
- Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to advise hiring leaders and navigate competing priorities across product and design searches.
- Strong operational rigor and the ability to stay organized amid change.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with an appropriate blend of professionalism and friendliness.

We are building C-Star, an open-source modeling platform that systematizes ocean modeling through automated, reproducible workflows, enabling reliable, high-fidelity simulations of ocean circulation and biogeochemistry. We are working with external partners to establish a broad user-base within academia, industry, and the larger ecosystem of climate-solutions actors.
